newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan April agri import value down 17.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan April agri import value down 17.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan's agriculture imports in April fell 17.3 percent to US$268.1 million from US$324.0 million in April 1996, the finance ministry said on Wednesday.
Grain and oilseeds were the top farm import items in April.
Taiwan traders attributed the reduction in April imports to shipment delays during the period.

Traders said many corn and soybean shipments were delayed because buyers tried to reduce their inventories as demand for animal feed plunged following the outbreak of a hog foot and mouth disease in March.
The deadly virus has been detected on 5,777 of Taiwan's 25,000 hog farms, according to latest figures released by Taiwan's Department of Agriculture and Forestry.
The department predicted that up to 4.3 million of the island's 14 million hogs have been, or would have to be, destroyed because of the epidemic.
Import tonnages in April were not available.
